question: With which of the following sports is Samiya Imad Farooqui associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samiya Imad Farooqui**__ 

 __
 
• **Samiya Farooqui is an Indian-born Badminton Player.**
 
• **She has won the Silver medal at the Junior Grand Prix, 2017 in the Singles event.**
 
• She along with Gayatri Pullela are one of India's top emerging Doubles players and is supported by the GoSports Foundation through the Abhinav Bindra Targeting Performance Programme.
 
• She is currently ranked 3rd in the National U-17 Singles Rankings.
 
• Her talent and ability are complimented well by the wonderful support structure she has around her.
 
• **She aims to represent and win medals for India at the international stage in her age category in the next five years.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Badminton**__

 
 
• **Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.**
 
• **The most common forms of the game are "singles" and "doubles".**
 
• Points are scored by striking the shuttlecock with the racquet and landing it within the opposing side's half of the court.
 
• Shuttlecocks also have a high tip speed compared to the balls in other racquet sports.
 
• The flight of the shuttlecock gives the sport its distinctive nature.
